integration.robust: p_robust_j=max_s p_j,s; valid for union of the explicitly admitted scenarios if every p_j,s is valid for its null
integration.bonferroni: p_FWER_j=min(1,5*p_robust_j); Bonferroni, arbitrary dependence; same5used for all claims
integration.interface_mapping: All valid bound statuses map to V2 VALID_UNIFORM_NULL_OR_CONSERVATIVE_BOUND only after this proposed method/policy is adopted and scientific certificates are verified; UNAVAILABLE/INVALID remain missing/invalid. Explicitly expose resource-trivial branch.

calibration_per_test_per_scenario.rule: No unavailable or invalid value is replaced by zero, non-rejection or a numeric sigma. Raw valid statistics and relative Bayes outputs remain separately visible.

V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.complete_test_j: For every frozen admitted scenario exactly once, a valid statistic and valid uniformly conservative null p upper bound including numerical uncertainty are available; no omitted scenarios. Certified equivalent scenario coverage may substitute only with a frozen proof and full label mapping.
V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.p_robust_j: Defined only if complete_test_j; maximum over every admitted scenario p upper bound, not a maximum over the available subset.
V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.H1_rejected: reject_COMPAT_H1 OR reject_LAW_H1_VS_FREE; either valid complete rejection remains reportable if the other test is unavailable, with that missing state visible.
V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.H1_calibrated_not_rejected: complete_test_COMPAT_H1 AND complete_test_LAW_H1_VS_FREE AND NOT reject_COMPAT_H1 AND NOT reject_LAW_H1_VS_FREE. This means only not rejected by the adopted tests, not model validation.
V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.combined_discrimination_H1_from_Hj: H1_calibrated_not_rejected AND complete_test_Hj_TO_H1 AND all admitted scenarios have certified positive T_j1 AND reject_Hj_TO_H1; j=2,4,5 separately.
V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.NOT_FALSIFIED_IN_THIS_CONTRACT: Allowed only when H1_calibrated_not_rejected. Missing rival comparisons remain explicitly unavailable; they are not required to report the two valid non-rejections of H1.
V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.CALIBRATION_UNAVAILABLE_OR_PARTIAL: If any claimed test lacks complete_test_j, its robust decision is unavailable; retain its valid raw per-scenario values and identify missing/invalid scenarios. Do not suppress any other valid rejection or evidence output.
V2_decision_predicates_unchanged.power: Independent final field; never turns missing calibration into non-rejection, nor suppresses a calibrated rejection.

integration.threshold_interval_comparison: p_FWER<=alpha_lo certifies rejection; p_FWER>alpha_hi certifies this bound does not reject; overlap is comparison unresolved, not numerical threshold adjustment
